payload.description: Deterministic transcripts recorded from the session graph's mock mode, one per scenario in src/eval/learning_benchmark.LEARNING_SCENARIOS. The WO-W08 soft completion gate (05-WEDGE-WORK-ORDERS.md §5.1, the dashed W03 -> W08 edge), closed by WO-W11 once WO-W03's graph and WO-W10's simulator both merged. Re-record with `make record-learning-fixtures` (python -m src.eval.record_learning_fixtures) after any change to the session graph or tutor copy; the recording is byte-identical apart from the commit stamp, and tests/test_record_learning_fixtures.py fails if the checked-in files stop matching what the graph produces.
payload.name: recorded_mock_session_transcripts
